related_questions.question: Can blood pressure medication cause fatigue?
What are some common blood pressure medications?

text_blocks.snippet: Losartan is a prescription blood pressure medication that can cause common, mild side effects like dizziness and fatigue, as well as rare, serious risks like high potassium levels and kidney changes.
Most common effects are mild and improve as your body adjusts:

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up)
Upper respiratory infections or a stuffy nose
High potassium (hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness or an irregular heartbeat.
Kidney problems: May cause changes in urination or swelling in the hands and feet.
Low blood pressure (hypotension): Can cause fainting or extreme lightheadedness.
Allergic reaction (angioedema): Causes dangerous swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Fetal harm: Losartan has a boxed warning and must not be taken during pregnancy.

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more comprehensive details on the Mayo Clinic Losartan Guide or the GoodRx Losartan Overview.
If you are taking losartan, tell me:

list.snippet: Are you experiencing any specific symptoms right now?
Do you have a history of kidney issues or high potassium?
